ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'And We exalted your fame' mean in Surah Ash-Sharh?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted not only as a general elevation of the Prophet's status but specifically as the raising of the 'Dhikr' (remembrance) of the Ahl al-Bayt, linking the Prophet's legacy to his progeny. This divine promise underscores the enduring spiritual authority of the Prophet and his family, ensuring their names remain central to Islamic identity and devotion throughout history.
